name: Sequence tools
description: A sequence map block, a DNA field with its own input, a GC-content cell, a library page, a settings page, a Home card and a report section, written in TypeScript with d3 bundled in.
author: Acme Bio

operations.title: Analyse a sequence
operations.description: Gives the length, the GC content as a percentage and the count of each base for a DNA sequence.

inputs.name: sequence
inputs.description: DNA letters A, C, G, T or N. Spaces and line breaks are ignored.

blocks.title: Sequence map
blocks.description: A circular map of a sequence, shaded by GC content; the sequence is kept with the block.

field-types.title: DNA sequence
field-types.description: Letters A, C, G, T and N, typed in a box that shows the GC content and a map as you type.
field-types.patternMessage: Use the letters A, C, G, T or N.

pages.title: Sequence library
pages.description: Paste a sequence to see its map and numbers.

dashboard-widgets.title: Quick GC check
dashboard-widgets.description: GC content of anything you paste.

report-sections.title: Sequence summary
report-sections.description: Adds the length, GC content and base counts of a sequence to a report.
